name: Zhejiang Sunriver Culture Tourism Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Sunriver Culture Tourism Co.,Ltd. engages in the tourism business in China. The company offers tourist attractions, tourism and vacation, and tourism services; and services, including transportation, audio guides, and ticket management services, as well as operation of supporting facilities; and hotel services. It also provides tourism and cruise and itinerary tour services. In addition, the company engages in smart cultural tourism and low-altitude cultural tourism business; sale of tea products under the Xiangyuan Tea name; animation and animated film and television activities; and venue and property leasing.
